name: Sonnet concentrated AI/technology
strategy: Cross-sector momentum/relative-value: long confirmed sector breakouts (biotech, financials, regional banks), short confirmed breakdowns (gold miners, long bonds) and crypto weakness, avoiding AI/semis entirely.

positions.thesis: Confirmed multi-month biotech breakout intact: still trading near its 52-week high ($154.23 vs $165.71 high), +76.96% 1yr, powered by record 2026 M&A activity and rotation out of expensive AI names. No new information breaks this thesis this week; holding unchanged.

Regional-bank uptrend remains confirmed and undisturbed: trading near its 52-week high ($76.21 vs $78.35 high), +31.48% 1yr including dividends, on continued lending strength, fee income, and post-stress-test dividend hikes. Holding unchanged.

Structural long-bond downtrend is the strongest working thesis in the book: TLT sits at $82.52, essentially at its 52-week low ($81.89), yields at highest levels since 2007, described this week as a 'perfect storm for generational losses' in long-duration treasuries. Holding unchanged.

Replaces the stopped-out GDX short with a genuine confirmed breakdown in the mandate's other permitted short bucket (crypto weakness): IBIT is down ~44% over the past year, trading near its 52-week low ($36.80 vs $71.82 high), in what coverage explicitly calls a 'classic bear market' with negative ETF flows and weakening institutional bitcoin demand -- unlike gold miners, this downtrend has not reversed or squeezed.
